species.evidence: inferred: MS spectra were searched using the Andromeda built-in search engine against the Uniprot-Swissprot human proteome database (version download 2017.06.12).

tissue.evidence: Two samples sets of breast cancer tissues (set 1: 21 samples and set 2: 24 samples) were analyzed by RNA-sequencing and MS analyses.

disease_state.evidence: All specimens were collected from women with primary breast cancer, who underwent tumor resection between 1991 and 2004.

sample_source.evidence: All specimens were collected from women with primary breast cancer, who underwent tumor resection between 1991 and 2004.

BMI: This subset of samples was selected based on the following clinical criteria: a breast volume of more than 800 mL, no previous case nor familial history of breast or ovarian cancer, nonsmoker, no diabetes mellitus, and a body mass index below 30.

material_type: Out of a large breast cancer dataset consisting of 172 samples, a subset of 21 frozen breast tissue specimens was collected for this study (Figure 1A).
